decisions.reason: It has strong quantified results, government use and over 30 APIS connections, so it clearly meets aspirations and gives no reason to search for alternatives.
Demand for travel health requirements is falling after the pandemic and no results are reported, but its own page and the expanding firm's slack let it carry the product for now.
This training module is close to the core business, costs little to maintain and draws on the firm's certified trainers, so the growing firm's slack lets it carry it despite unreported results.
Behaviour analysis is a core aviation security capability that builds on established know-how, so keeping it under slack is reasonable even without evidence of results.
Passenger profiling is central to the firm's specialist detection offer, and with no evidence of a shortfall and the firm expanding, there is little pressure to drop it.
The verification platform has its own page, is close to the established offer and fits the firm's integrated travel document services, so it is likely to be retained.
